extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders in global health governance (donors, implementers, Board members, partner organizations, civil society, affected communities)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and institutional standards describing the Global Fund Board's roles, composition, committee structure, and supporting governance documents used to oversee the Fund's work on HIV, TB and malaria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board partnership approach
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board of the Global Fund embodies the partnership approach to global health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Board incorporates leading stakeholders in an inclusive and effective way to help end the epidemics of HIV, TB and malaria. The Global Fund’s guiding philosophy, and the day-to-day work of the Board, embraces shared responsibility and a strong commitment by all involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategy development
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — the Board is responsible for developing strategy to guide the Fund's work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance oversight
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — the Board provides oversight of governance arrangements and adherence to policies and bylaws.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment of financial resources
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — the Board commits financial resources for Global Fund activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment of organizational performance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — the Board assesses the organization's performance against objectives and strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Risk management
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — the Board oversees identification and management of risks to the organization and its programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership engagement, resource mobilization and advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnership engagement, resource mobilization and advocacy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a core function of the Board — includes engaging partners, mobilizing resources and advocating for the Fund's priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board composition: voting membership
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board includes 20 voting members, with equal representation by implementers and donors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-governmental organizations; communities affected by HIV, TB and malaria; the private sector; and private foundations are also represented as voting members. See 'Members and Constituencies' for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Board composition: non-voting membership
rubrics_metrics.description: There are eight non-voting members, including the Board Chair and Vice-Chair; representatives of partner organizations including the World Health Organization and World Bank; as well as the Additional Public Donors constituency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-voting membership composition is specified to ensure partner representation and participation without voting rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The work of the Board operates through three committees: Audit and Finance Committee; Ethics and Governance Committee; Strategy Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A Coordinating Group, led by the Board Chair, serves as a collaborative body to coordinate important business of the Board. See 'Committees' for more information and charters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory and operational structures reporting to the Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory and operational structures that report to the Board include the Secretariat, Technical Review Panel, and Office of the Inspector General.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These bodies provide operational support, technical review of grant proposals, and independent oversight/audit functions respectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal governance documents (bylaws, operating procedures, charters, terms of reference)
rubrics_metrics.description: Operating Procedures of the Board and Committees; Bylaws of the Global Fund; committee charters; Board Chair and Vice-Chair Terms of Reference; Independent Evaluation Panel Terms of Reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Board's roles, procedures and institutional arrangements are defined in formal documents (available as PDFs) such as operating procedures, bylaws, and charters which provide detailed rules, mandates and terms of reference for Board members and committees.
